$comment: Runtime config for this landing. Served as-is next to index.html and fetched on every page load, so editing it changes the landing WITHOUT any build. Anything omitted falls back to the built-in defaults in assets/plinko.config.js.

game.$comment: balance/bet in game.currency. ctaAfterDrops = popup after this many drops. Multipliers, pin counts, ball speed and other timings are hardcoded in assets/plinko.js.

dev.$comment: menu: config panel (top right) — edits are saved to this browser only (localStorage); use its Download button and replace this file to publish. watch: poll this file and re-render open pages when it changes (off in production: one request every watchInterval ms per page).
